description: Returns KP Placidus cusps (tropical cusp longitudes checked against six Swiss Ephemeris reference values; abstains where Placidus is undefined at high latitudes), KP sidereal positions using Lahiri with the corpus-specified 6′ correction (located in the source, not reproduced against a reference), Nakshatra star, sub and sub-sub lords, ruling planets and significator evidence. Rulers, significators and event logic are a structural preview, not independently certified.
